Interest rates: 1/01/2026–3/31/2026
* There are a number of state and local governmental bodies that have interest rates tied to the overpayment and underpayment rates contained in either Tax Law section 697(j) (Income Tax) or section 1096(e) (Corporation Tax). For purposes of Tax Law section 697(j) and section 1096(e), the overpayment rate for this period is 6%. For purposes of Tax Law section 697(j), the underpayment rate for this period is 9.5%. For purposes of Tax Law section 1096(e), the underpayment rate for this period is 11%.
Interest rates: 4/1/2026–6/30/2026
* There are a number of state and local governmental bodies that have interest rates tied to the overpayment and underpayment rates contained in either Tax Law section 697(j) (Income Tax) or section 1096(e) (Corporation Tax). For purposes of Tax Law section 697(j) and Tax Law section 1096(e), the overpayment rate for this period is 5%. For purposes of Tax Law section 697(j), the underpayment rate for this period is 8.5%. For purposes of Tax Law section 1096(e), the underpayment rate for this period is 10%.
Interest rates: 7/1/2026–9/30/2026
* There are a number of state and local governmental bodies that have interest rates tied to the overpayment and underpayment rates contained in either Tax Law section 697(j) (Income Tax) or section 1096(e) (Corporation Tax). For purposes of Tax Law section 697(j) and Tax Law section 1096(e), the overpayment rate for this period is 6%. For purposes of Tax Law section 697(j), the underpayment rate for this period is 9.5%. For purposes of Tax Law section 1096(e), the underpayment rate for this period is 11%.
Interest rates: 10/1/2026–12/31/2026
* There are a number of state and local governmental bodies that have interest rates tied to the overpayment and underpayment rates contained in either section 697(j) (Income Tax) or section 1096(e) (Corporation Tax) of the Tax Law. For purposes of section 697(j) and section 1096(e) of the Tax Law, the overpayment rate for this period is 6%. For purposes of section 697(j) of the Tax Law, the underpayment rate for this period is 9.5%. For purposes of section 1096(e) of the Tax Law, the underpayment rate for this period is 11%.
